blocks.text: The true cost of seasonal demand spikes

When you fail to anticipate seasonal demand spikes, the financial impact is immediate. Overstocks cost companies $562 billion in 2023. These goods take up valuable warehouse space and tie up capital that could fund other operations. Understocks are equally damaging. They lead to lost sales and damaged customer loyalty that is hard to recover.

The human cost is often ignored. Supply chain teams face severe staffing shortages, with 76% of organizations reporting gaps. This forces existing staff to work excessive overtime. The resulting burnout leads to higher turnover rates, which hit 28% for managers in a single year. When your most experienced people leave, your institutional knowledge leaves with them.

Most companies treat seasonal planning as a once a year event. This is a mistake. You must treat it as a continuous, integrated program. When you view the supply chain as a series of isolated silos, you create bottlenecks. For example, you might secure shipping capacity but fail to update your warehouse labor contracts. This mismatch causes delays that ripple through your entire network.

Unpredictability is the new normal. Traditional holiday patterns are disrupted by weather, geopolitics, and shifting consumer habits. If you rely on static spreadsheets, you cannot react to these changes in real time. You end up in survival mode, where tired planners make reactive decisions that increase the chance of error.

items: Start your planning sequence months in advance, not weeks.
Use what if scenario modeling to test the impact of supplier delays.
Shift to flexible warehousing instead of long term, rigid leases.
Automate repetitive tasks like inventory tracking to free up your team.

blocks.text: You do not need expensive software to start improving your process. Begin by cleaning your data. Use Excel or Google Sheets to create a consistent format for your demand history. If you are on a Mac, use keyboard shortcuts like ⌘ + ⌥ + V to paste values only, which prevents formula errors when consolidating data from different departments.
Managing your Mac workflow with Lazur

As a planner, you spend hours in Outlook and Excel. Lazur helps you manage this by acting as a voice assistant that understands your screen. When you are looking at a complex spreadsheet and need to find a specific cell or menu, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur circles the area on your screen, saving you the time of hunting through menus.

faq.question: Why is seasonal planning so difficult for supply chain planners?
faq.answer: It is difficult because it involves managing complex dependencies, unpredictable market shifts, and manual data processes that are prone to human error.

faq.question: Can I use Mac tools for supply chain planning?
faq.answer: Yes. Most modern planning platforms like Anaplan, Pigment, and GMDH Streamline are cloud based and run perfectly in Safari or Chrome on macOS.

faq.question: How does Lazur help with supply chain tasks?
faq.answer: Lazur helps by pointing at screen elements, answering questions about your current task, and dictating reports or emails, which reduces the time spent on repetitive manual work.
